company.name: Wenzhou Ashal Innomach Technology Co., Ltd.
company.description: Designs and manufactures blown-film lines, bag-making converters, and recycling systems for polymer film processors across six continents.

values.title: Engineering first
values.description: Every machine starts on the drawing board, not the sales brochure. We over-engineer where it matters — drive trains, die heads, frame rigidity — and simplify everything else.

values.title: Long-term support
values.description: We supply spare parts and provide remote process support for every machine we have ever built.

values.title: Material agnostic
values.description: Our lines run LDPE, LLDPE, HDPE, PP, PBAT+PLA and blends.

values.title: Factory transparency
values.description: Buyers are welcome on the production floor at any stage of a build.

timeline.event: Company founded in Wenzhou, Zhejiang. First single-layer blown-film line.
ABA three-layer co-extrusion line introduced. First export orders to Southeast Asia.
Bag-making division launched with the F-PRO bottom-seal converter.
ABC multi-layer line certified for PBAT+PLA biodegradable resin. European CE marking achieved.
CX recycling and pelletizing line released. Factory floor expanded to 12,000 m².
Five-layer ABCDE-2200 enters development. Sales offices opened in Germany and Vietnam.
ABCDE-2200 begins shipping. RGB roll-bag machine updated with motorised width adjustment.
